text: Ship: task tracker - create tasks with title, notes, due date, priority; mark done; filter by status; Android works offline and syncs.
Toolchain: JDK 21, git, gh (naddanki87) OK. No Android SDK/Gradle locally - APK will be built by GitHub Actions.
GATE 0: PASS - toolchain recorded, branch feat/task-tracker created
Drafting API contract for review: 6 endpoints under /api/v1/tasks, UUID ids, optimistic version, soft delete, /changes sync feed.
Approved. Client-generated UUIDs + PUT upsert cover offline create; sync checkpoint uses server updatedAt, not device clock.
Approved. Will use saveAndFlush so returned version is already incremented.
Approved for v1 without auth (single-tenant, no personal data). Watch the sort param - unknown property must be 400, not 500.
GATE 1: PASS - contract approved by Byte, Swift and Armor (docs/SPEC.md, docs/openapi.yaml)
Scaffolded Spring Boot 4.1.2 via Initializr; added springdoc 3.2.0; removed h2console.
Implemented Task entity, repository, TaskService (create/list/get/upsert/delete/changes), TaskController, DTOs, ProblemDetail handler, SecurityConfig.
Web UI ready in static/: create form, All/Open/Done filter, toggle done via PUT+version, delete. textContent only.
Android app ready: SQLite in internal storage, offline create/edit/done/delete, lossless sync (dirty + updated_at guard), https-only release.
Backend compiles: target/task-tracker-1.0.0.jar (67 MB). Android build delegated to CI.
GATE 2: PASS - backend compiles, web and Android sources complete
SEC-1 [Medium] GET /tasks?sort=bogus falls into the catch-all and returns 500. Must be 400.
SEC-2 [Medium] Missing since param and other Spring MVC errors return 500. Map them to their 4xx status.
Patched SEC-1/SEC-2 in GlobalExceptionHandler (PropertyReferenceException, MissingServletRequestParameterException, ErrorResponse 4xx). Also fixed the skill template. Ready for re-audit.
Writing JUnit 5 suite: service unit tests, @DataJpaTest repository, @WebMvcTest validation, full @SpringBootTest API flow mapped to AC-1..AC-12.
Running ./mvnw test (4 test classes, AC-1..AC-12 + SEC-1/SEC-2 regression)…
Build FAILED: GlobalExceptionHandler.java:12 cannot find symbol PropertyReferenceException (package moved in Spring Data 4). Please fix.
Fixed: PropertyReferenceException now imported from org.springframework.data.core (Spring Data 4). Template updated with a Boot 3 note. Please re-run.
Re-running ./mvnw test…
Backend: 23 tests run, 0 failed, 0 skipped (service 7, repository 3, API integration 12, context 1).
Writing Android local unit tests for TaskValidator and TaskJson (offline model + sync mapping).
Android local unit tests: 6 run, 0 failed (TaskValidator 3, TaskJson 3). Full Gradle build + APK runs in CI.
Re-auditing SEC-1/SEC-2 against the new regression test badInputNeverReturns500 and errorsDoNotLeakInternals…
SEC-6 [Medium] Startup log prints "Using generated security password" - Spring creates a default in-memory user. Credential in logs. Remove the default user.
SEC-6 fixed: empty InMemoryUserDetailsManager bean replaces the generated user (app + skill template). Re-running tests.
Re-run after SEC-6: 23 backend + 6 Android = 29 run, 0 failed. Startup log verified free of credentials.
Security sign-off: 0 Critical/High open. Fixed SEC-1, SEC-2, SEC-3, SEC-6; SEC-4 (no auth in v1) and SEC-5 (debug cleartext) accepted. docs/SECURITY-AUDIT.md
GATE 3: PASS - Armor signed off, 29/29 tests green (docs/TEST-REPORT.md)
Extracting endpoints from TaskController + /v3/api-docs to generate README, API reference with curl examples, and decisions log.
Building executable JAR (./mvnw clean package) and smoke-testing it on port 18080…
Smoke test passed: java -jar task-tracker-1.0.0.jar - health UP, create/update/version OK, sort=bogus 400, Swagger 200, web UI list + filter verified in browser.
Docs ready: README.md (run, env vars, APK install, internal-storage note), docs/API.md (curl for all 6 endpoints), docs/DECISIONS.md (10 decisions + handoffs).
11 Conventional Commits on feat/task-tracker (c30229c..aa26658). Pushing to github.com/naddanki87/antechsolutions…
CI run 41015771029: backend job green, android job FAILED. Pulling the log.
Root cause: android-actions/setup-android@v3 default installs the removed "tools" package (sdkmanager exit 1). Not a code error. Fixing workflow + skill template to install platform-tools only.
